notes.title: Beta Update 6/11
notes.content:
Beta Update

+Added new Mail System! Townsfolk will reward you for hobby levels, townsfolk heart levels, and museum donation milestones with mail!
+Adjusted EXP formula for hobbies/Townsfolk. Every 2 levels, the cap increases by 1. Every 10 levels, the cap also increases by 5.
+The EXP formula is still subject to change. Hopefully this is the sweet spot.
+I don't want players to achieve 99 in anything within their first year of playing!
+Townsfolk gain double heart exp for normal talking.
+Ash now unlocks the Quarry
+Implemented Silver Tools, you can now hover over your tools in inventory to see what they do.
+Dudley gives you the Tree Stump Blueprint so you can regrow trees
+Reduced target framerate, hopefully will not make certain computers run hot. Let me know!
+Crops will now grow even if they have objects in the spaces ABOVE and BELOW them. (Allows more freedom and versatile farm layouts)
+Enabled Mouse (A bit finicky still with certain buttons, please let me know if there are any huge issues that arise with mouse!)
+Added pointer hand to the keyboard keys in the main game scene
+Trees now get chopped properly in the Endless Forest
+Smoother fish animation when interested in your bobber
+Fixed not being able to access inventory when placing items in the marketplace
+Added holding down space for crafting!
+Fixed houses/structures/objects being spawned outside of town!
+Fixed 2 Bubsy house bug
+Event sign now shines for events that are actually implemented
+Cannot go negative when quick cooking in the Tavern
+Every day 1-3 dishes will be eaten at the tavern instead of just 1
+Fixed water fountain sound even when fountain is hidden due to event
+Fixed not being able to play in the casino with only 1 deluca coin
+Fixed Mel's dialogue a bit and added a tiny bit more, still a lot to do for all townsfolk.
+Fixed z value on ore deposits in cavern
+Fixed Mel spawning in main town before Deluca
+Townsfolk now let you know that you should build a desk in your own home to view your PERSONAL GOALS.
+Fixed pointer hand blocking raycasts
+Fixed bonus item text color and sound
+Added the Quest Board which is given to you by Laura
+Fixed invisible wall on leftmost part of map
+Fixed Dudley not giving you his hand me down furniture
+Updated the Townsfolk section of your journal with descriptions and unlock conditions (Last 2 cannot be obtained just yet)
+Added various sound effects
+Change the plus sign from a well nights rest to the left side of the energy bar so as to not block visibility
+Updated hobby menu to show hobby levels
+Increased size of mailbox menu
+You can now sit in your chair when interacting from above
+better animations on build cost panel when spawning object
